star_stories.title: Fail-closed release-candidate evidence
star_stories.situation: The release-candidate checkpoint needed to distinguish locally executed evidence from browser tests that could only run in CI in the build environment.
star_stories.task: Prevent a recruiter-facing or release-facing report from presenting an unexecuted browser test as a factual pass.
star_stories.action: Implemented an explicit RC_READY_FOR_CI state and retained the browser gate as mandatory CI enforcement instead of fabricating local Playwright execution.
star_stories.result_template: The local release-candidate evidence still recorded {rc_regression_passed} passing regression tests and {coverage_percent} Python coverage while preserving the browser execution limitation explicitly.

star_stories.title: Removed demo identity from production approval path
star_stories.situation: Architecture-integrity review found an earlier demo-era reviewer fallback inside the production approval boundary.
star_stories.task: Ensure consequential approval reads and decisions use authenticated production identity and role context.
star_stories.action: Removed demo reviewer fallbacks and required gateway user/role context, while retaining dry-run and human-approval safety controls.
star_stories.result_template: The architecture-integrity report completed with no recorded findings after the production boundary was hardened.

star_stories.title: Designed bounded multimodal degradation
star_stories.situation: Large multimodal investigations must remain traceable when an extractor fails instead of silently dropping evidence or exhausting resources.
star_stories.task: Keep image, PDF, audio, and video processing bounded while preserving evidence lineage through partial failures.
star_stories.action: Added hard work-unit limits, redaction-before-persistence, stable trace IDs, explicit DEGRADED evidence states, and a minimum surviving-evidence threshold.
star_stories.result_template: The clean checkpoint retained {multimodal_traceability} traceability and the partial-failure fixture preserved degraded evidence lineage rather than hiding failed modalities.

star_stories.title: Converted architecture documentation into an executable contract
star_stories.situation: A large multi-service portfolio can drift when diagrams, release metadata, Helm images, and actual service boundaries are maintained independently.
star_stories.task: Make the documented architecture verifiably match deployed topology and data flows.
star_stories.action: Created one machine-readable topology model and generated/validated diagrams, workload versions, Compose services, security boundaries, and runtime paths from it.
star_stories.result_template: The final topology validates {architecture_nodes} nodes and {architecture_flows} data-flow edges with no findings in the production architecture report.

tradeoffs.decision: Keep NestJS as the sole public application API while Python AI services remain private.
tradeoffs.tradeoff: This adds an internal service boundary and contract maintenance cost, but isolates AI execution, centralizes authentication/tenant policy, and keeps browser clients away from private model/tool endpoints.

tradeoffs.decision: Require dry-run plus human approval for consequential remediation rather than autonomous writes.
tradeoffs.tradeoff: This sacrifices maximum automation speed for auditability, blast-radius control, and safer production operation.

tradeoffs.decision: Bound multimodal work units and allow explicit PARTIAL results when enough evidence survives.
tradeoffs.tradeoff: This may omit expensive evidence beyond configured limits, but prevents unbounded work and preserves degraded-source traceability.

cost_latency_decisions.statement_template: Use the clean-index checkpoint to catch algorithmic retrieval regressions early; its cold p95 was {rag_cold_p95_ms}, explicitly treated as an in-process benchmark rather than production network latency.

The synthetic multimodal recruiter flow carries a configured latency budget of {demo_latency_budget_ms} ms and an estimated LLM cost of {demo_estimated_cost_usd}; both are labelled budget/estimate values rather than measured production performance or billing.

failure_lessons.lesson: Do not equate CI wiring with local execution. Record environment limitations explicitly and fail closed on missing evidence.
Demo conveniences must not survive inside production authorization paths; periodic scope-control reviews should scan production entrypoints for mock identities and bypasses.
Versioned deployment artifacts can drift independently; compare release metadata, Helm image tags, canary tags, diagrams, and runtime topology in one executable architecture gate.

recruiter_questions: What real problem does VeriDeploy AI solve beyond being an LLM wrapper?
How does your RAG pipeline prevent unsupported claims and preserve citations?
Why did you use NestJS plus Python instead of exposing the Python AI service directly?
How does LangGraph checkpointing and restart recovery work in your design?
How are MCP tool calls governed and audited?
What happens when PDF or video extraction fails during an incident investigation?
Which numbers on your resume are actually measured, and what environment produced them?
How do you keep consequential AI actions from executing autonomously?
How do Kafka ordering, retries, idempotency, and DLQ handling work?
What would you need to validate before calling the system production-ready in a real company environment?
